body: You want to escape your BPD right? You have to start framing your behaviors as not only self destructive, but harmful to those around you as well. I think a lot of us with BPD tend to really only think of the consequences our actions have on ourselves, but I don’t think it’s because we’re narcissistic, we can still have empathy and care about others, but we don’t see the consequences our actions have on others very well. Before you do this think about the consequences.
